turns.t: Hello there! I've come for my spirometry results, the breathing test. I don't have any symptoms, I want to be clear, but my daughter says I should have it checked because I've smoked for years.
That's a sensible approach. Before we look at the results, let me ask a few things. How many years did you smoke?
Thirty-five years. Twenty a day. I gave up two years ago.
Any cough, or wheeze, or breathlessness? ~
None, honestly. I walk the dog for an hour every day. ~
What are you taking?
A statin, atorvastatin, 20 mg at night, and a tablet for blood pressure, ramipril, 5 mg once a day.
Any health conditions?
High cholesterol, and high blood pressure.
Any operations?
Just my appendix, as a teenager.
Any lung problems in the family?
My father had emphysema.
Right. Let me check your numbers. ~
Go on. ~
Pulse 72, blood pressure 130 over 80, oxygen 98 percent, weight 84 kilos.
Fine? ~
Fine. Now, the spirometry results. Your FEV1, the amount you can blow out in one second, is 88 percent of what's predicted for your age and height, and the ratio is normal. ~
Is that good? ~
That's a normal result. There's no sign of COPD or obstruction. ~
That's a relief. ~
Given your history of smoking, I'm glad we checked. It tells me your lungs have come through remarkably well. ~
What about my father's emphysema? ~
Emphysema in a heavy smoker is usually due to smoking itself, and not strongly inherited. ~
That's good. ~
You've done the right thing by stopping. The risk to your lungs falls every year. ~
I feel proud of that. ~
You should. I'd like to arrange a lung cancer screening check, a low-dose scan, as you may qualify, given your age and smoking history.
A scan? Is that necessary? ~
It's a screening offer for people in your group, to catch problems early, when they're easiest to treat. I'd like you to have it. ~
Okay. ~
And I'd also like to arrange a blood test, to check your cholesterol and kidney function, since you're on the statin and ramipril.
Fine. ~
Keep walking the dog, keep off cigarettes, and have your flu and pneumonia jabs.
I've had the flu jab. ~
Good. I'd like to see you again in three months, with the scan result.
Three months. Thank you, doctor. ~
